original: 共和党の旗を掲げて初めてホワイトハウス入りしたのは、この州の人でした。そのことを思い出しましょう。共和党とは、自助自立に個人の自由、そして国の統一という価値観を掲げて作られた政党です。そうした価値は、私たち全員が共有するものです。そして民主党は確かに今夜、大きな勝利を獲得しましたが、私たちはいささか謙虚に、そして決意を持って、この国の前進を阻んでいた分断を癒すつもりです。

en.text: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

original: 確かに火曜日は寒かったですね。

en.text: Tuesday was certainly cold.

original: 確かにあなたの言い分は正しいかもしれません。

en.text: Certainly you may well be right.

original: 人間的な、余りに人間的なものは大抵は確かに動物的である。

en.text: Things that are human, too human, are generally certainly animal.

original: 確かに、人の行動を法で規制することはできない。法で君が僕を愛するようにすることはできない。しかし君が僕をリンチにかけることがないようにはできる。そういうことはある意味で重要なことだと思う。

en.text: It is true that behavior cannot be legislated, and legislation cannot make you love me, but legislation can restrain you from lynching me, and I think that is kind of important.

original: 確かに、現代社会は消費が人々の生活に重要な役割を果たし、幸福や喜びに強く結 びついているのも当然のことといえる。

en.text: Surely, in the present-day society, we might as well consider it natural that consumption plays an important role in the life of man and is closely related to his well-being and happiness.

original: アトピーのためかかった病院で、刺激の少ないというシャンプーを勧められた。確かに効果はあるようなのだが、これがとても高価で困っている。

en.text: The hospital that I went to for my allergies recommended me a shampoo that wouldn't trigger them. It's certainly effective - I think - but it's just way too expensive.

original: トムさんは確かに賢いです。

en.text: Tom certainly is smart.

original: 確かに、これはそうです。

en.text: This is very true.

original: トムは自分のしていたことは違法だと確かにわかっていた。

en.text: Tom certainly knew that what he was doing was illegal.
Tom certainly knew what he was doing was illegal.

original: トムは確かに裕福な家の出身であるようだ。

en.text: Tom certainly sounds like he comes from a rich family.

original: トムは確かに勉強したが、そんなにやってはいなかった。

en.text: Tom did study, but he didn't study very much.

original: 彼は確かに頭が切れる。

en.text: He certainly is smart.

en.text: "It seems that these days there's a murder somewhere every day." "Indeed. It's a dangerous world, isn't it?"

original: 確かにこれはただの誤解です。

en.text: I'm sure this is all a misunderstanding.
I'm sure this is just a misunderstanding.

original: 確かに彼は成功を望んだのだが、実際はまったく駄目だった。

en.text: Of course he hoped for success. But in reality it turned out to be no good at all.

original: 「久しぶりに真面目な話したね」「確かに。普段アホみたいな話しかしないもんね」

en.text: "It's been a while since we had a serious conversation, eh." "That's for sure. We usually only have idiotic conversations."

original: 確かに、間違ってるかもしれませんね。

en.text: It may, indeed, be a mistake.

original: …分からない。でも確かに見たんだ。目から血を流した女の人を。

en.text: ... I'm not sure. But I'm sure I have seen her, a woman with blood flowing from her eyes.

original: 「トムって、親切だ」って言ってたけど、確かにそうだね。

en.text: You said Tom was kind and he certainly is, isn't he?

original: 「俺心配で６ｋｇ痩せたんですよ。少し戻りましたけど」「確かにこの間みた時よりほっそりしてるよ」

en.text: "Out of concern I've lost 6 kilograms. Though it's beginning to come back." "You certainly look a lot slimmer than when I saw you last."

original: 確かに、トムの言っていることは、理に適っています。

en.text: What Tom is saying is certainly reasonable.

original: 確かに難しい問題だよ。

en.text: It's certainly a difficult problem.
You know, it's certainly a difficult question.
It's certainly a difficult question, you know.
You know, it's certainly a difficult problem.

original: 確かに難問だね。

en.text: It's certainly a difficult question.
It's certainly a perplexing question.
It's certainly a perplexing problem.
It's certainly a difficult problem.

original: 確かに今の日本では、「ラジカセ」はもう古い言葉なのかもしれない。

en.text: The word "raji-kase", meaning radio cassette in Japan, is probably more of an antiquated term by now.

original: 確かに時間の無駄だな。

en.text: It's certainly a waste of time.

original: 父はわたしたちに、それは確かに本当だと言った。

en.text: My father told us that it is indeed true.

original: なるほど、確かに便利な機能ですね。

en.text: I see. That's certainly a useful feature.

original: 確かに牛乳とコーンフレークの相性は抜群だ。

en.text: Corn flakes and milk certainly go well together.

original: あの場所は確かに一見の価値ありですよ。

en.text: That place is certainly worth seeing.

original: これは、確かに朗報ね。

en.text: This is, indeed, a great piece of news.

original: これは確かに意外ですね。

en.text: This is certainly surprising.

original: トムは確かに一時期飲酒の問題がありましたが、今では全く飲みませんよ。

en.text: Tom did have a drinking problem for a while, but now he doesn't drink at all.

original: 確かにライターをやっていたことはあるけど、あれは作業員という感じでクリエイターという感じではなかったな。いや仕事の性質がということではなくて、自分自身の心構えがそうだったということだけど。

en.text: It's true that I've been a writer before, but that felt more like I was a worker rather than a creator. It wasn't the nature of the work itself so much as my own mindset about it.

original: メアリーって、確かにアリスにちょっと似てるね。

en.text: Mary does look a bit like Alice.

original: 「僕の字はどうして、選ばれなかったんですか？」「徹君の字は、確かにきれいなんだよ。基本もできてるし、全体的にも整ってる。ただね、気持ちがこもってないんだよ」「気持ち？」「そうだよ。筆にちゃんと自分の気持ちを込めないと、それはただの猿真似でしかないんだ。どうしたらいいかは、自分で考えてみて。次を期待してるよ」

en.text: "Why wasn’t my writing chosen?" "Toru, while your writing is certainly beautiful — you have the basics down and are well-organized overall — the feelings still just aren't there." "'Feelings'?" "Yes. If you don't put your personal feelings into your brushwork, it's rather lifeless. Think about how to do it in your own way. I'll be looking forward to seeing your next attempt."

original: 確かに今日は涼しいな。

en.text: You're right, it is quite chilly today.
It sure is cool today.
It's definitely cool today.

original: 確かに。

en.text: Definitely.
